description_en: Download the slow query logs of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 下载AnalyticDB PostgreSQL的实例的慢SQL记录
name: DownloadSQLLogsRecords

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The keywords that are used for query
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，且大于查询开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值说明：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值；默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The execution duration of the SQL statement. Unit: seconds
parameters.name: execute_cost

parameters.help_en:
The execution status of the SQL statement.

1: successful.
0: failed
parameters.name: execute_state

parameters.help_en: The type of the query language. Example: DQL, DML, or DDL
parameters.name: operation_class

parameters.help_en: The type of the SQL statement. Example: SELECT
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum amount of time consumed by a slow query. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 慢SQL最大耗时，取值需大于等于0，单位为秒（s）
parameters.name: max_execute_cost

parameters.help_en: The minimum amount of time consumed by a slow query. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 慢SQL最小耗时，取值需大于等于0，单位为秒（s）
parameters.name: min_execute_cost

parameters.help_en:
The language of the file that contains the query diagnostic information. Valid values:

zh: simplified Chinese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese.
zh-tw: traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
下载文件的语言，取值如下：

zh：简体中文。
en：英文。
ja：日语。
zh-tw：繁体中文
parameters.name: lang

DownloadId.description_en: The ID of the download task
